text:
Ravi (CS): Heads-up: Aurelia Medical renewal is up in 3 weeks. They want a 9-month bridge (shorter term) while their procurement finalizes a larger enterprise deal. Requests: split billing across US / UK / SG, dedicated reserve of 12 GPUs, and notarized wet-ink signature for SG legal. Also asked for a short data-residency clause for EU workloads.
Lena (RevOps): Noted. 9-month term -> we need prorated pricing. Any discount target?
Ravi (CS): They asked to keep current discount but extend usage commitments. Essentially keep 20% and push term down to 9mo.
Oscar (Finance): 20% on a shorter term reduces LTV. Propose two options:
```
A) 9mo @ 20% + upfront 50% payment
B) 9mo @ 12% + standard monthly billing
```
Pick one to present. Also need bill-to legal names + tax IDs for UK/SG.
Priya (Legal): Wet-ink in SG has local notarization steps. We'll need signer name + identity verification doc. I can draft a one-off addendum for notarization acceptance. Also confirm whether notarized docs must be returned via courier to customer or retained by us.
Noah (Enablement): If they want Dedicated staging, we should offer a pre-cutover validation window (5 business days) for KV cache and latency tests. Schedule runbook review with their infra lead.
Bill (SecurityBot): SECURITY CHECK: customer requested KMS cross-region replication. We require architecture diagram + third-party HSM vendor info. See: https://redwood.internal/security/kms-onboarding (internal).
Lena (RevOps): I'll build the SOW lines. Draft invoice example: 
- US Corp (EIN: 98-7654321): Dedicated 12-GPU reserve  $16,800/month  Net30
- UK Ltd (VAT: GB123456789): Shared ingress + compliance surcharge  200/month  Net30 (GBP invoiced)
- SG Pte (UEN: 201912345R): One-time notarization handling fee  SGD 380 + courier  Wire on receipt
(Amounts placeholders pending pricing model).
Oscar (Finance): For notarization fee, estimate SGD 350 + SGD 40 courier. Add 'document handling and courier' line item. Also include a clause for currency invoicing and FX responsibility.
Ravi (CS): Customer says procurement will provide a signed PO for the US entity by EOW if we accept upfront 50% for the 9mo option.
Priya (Legal): If they want PO-first, ensure PO references SOW version and signature matrix. I'll prepare a signer matrix template. Also add a short data residency clause: "EU workloads shall persist within EU region unless otherwise consented in writing."
Noah (Enablement): Training request: two workshops (app integration + infra handoff). Propose Wed 10am SGT and Tue 2pm ET. I can do recorded session for APAC folks.
Bill (SecurityBot): Also require SOC2 artifact and proof of vulnerability scan window. Attach: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2-summary-2025.pdf
Lena (RevOps): Action plan: I'll produce SOW v1 with both pricing options by EOD today. Oscar confirm fees and currency handling by noon. Priya will draft addendum + signing matrix tomorrow AM. Noah to propose calendar invites after SOW. Ravi to collect PO and signer names from Aurelia.
Oscar (Finance): Confirming: will validate tax treatments and withholding implications for SG by noon. If PO arrives with upfront payment, finance will process CC fallback if wire delayed.
Ravi (CS): Customer quote from call: "We can escalate to finance for upfront 50% on the US PO if you can give us staging access for 5 days and notarization assistance for SG."
Priya (Legal): Note on escrow ask: they mentioned wanting an escrow for encryption keys during cutover. We don't offer customer-managed escrow; we can offer attestation of HSM custody and an independent auditor statement. I'll draft language to that effect.
Bill (SecurityBot): If they need stronger key custody, we can offer HSM integration options: AWS CloudHSM, GCP HSM, or customer-provided external HSM. Need to know preferred vendor.
Ravi (CS): Great. Final item: lock provisioning at 12 GPUs in SOW; any increase requires new SOW and 30-day lead time.
Lena (RevOps): Noted. I'll add "provisioning freeze" clause. Draft link when ready: https://redwood.example.com/drafts/1771112223-aurelia-sow-v1
Priya (Legal): I'll comment inline on the addendum.
Noah (Enablement): Once SOW approved, I'll send invites.
Ravi (CS): Thanks team. I'll follow up with Aurelia for PO and signer list today. Ping me in thread if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
